# City stats (coverage metrics)

Each stat is the share of homes covered by the services that provide it (0-100%). A `need` stat lowers mood by `weight` x the uncovered share once the town is big enough to care (`need pop`); a `bonus` stat raises mood or income; `safety` has no direct mood effect.

| Stat | Kind | Mood weight | Provided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Fire safety](#fire-safety) | safety | 0 | Fire station |
| [Policing](#policing) | need | 0.06 | Police station, Barracks |
| [Healthcare](#healthcare) | need | 0.1 | Clinic, Hospital |
| [Education](#education) | need | 0.08 | School, Library, University |
| [Leisure](#leisure) | need | 0.12 | Park, Playground, Plaza, Cinema, Church, Bar, Stadium, Theme park, Shopping mall |
| [Culture](#culture) | bonus | 0.05 | Library, University, Plaza, Cinema, Museum, Church, Stadium |
| [Public transport](#public-transport) | need | 0.06 | Bus stop, Train station |
| [Electricity](#electricity) | need | 0.15 | Wind turbine, Solar farm, Coal power plant |
| [Water](#water) | need | 0.15 | Water tower |
| [Sewage](#sewage) | need | 0.1 | Sewage plant |
| [Waste disposal](#waste-disposal) | need | 0.08 | Landfill, Recycling centre |
| [Retail strength](#retail-strength) | bonus | 0 | Train station, Market, Shopping mall |
| [Banking](#banking) | bonus | 0 | Bank, Chamber of commerce |
| [Street lighting](#street-lighting) | safety | 0 | Street lamp |
| [Justice](#justice) | safety | 0 | Courthouse, Prison |
| [Defence](#defence) | bonus | 0.02 | Military base, Radar post |
| [Civic administration](#civic-administration) | bonus | 0.04 | Union hall, Town hall |

## Fire safety

Key `fire`. Share of homes within reach of a fire station. A fire inside a covered area is put out after 3 seconds; elsewhere it burns 14 seconds, destroys the building and spreads to neighbours.

> "One spark and this whole street goes up."

Provided by: Fire station.

## Policing

Key `police`. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -12%) and let crime drain your treasury (theft costs roughly 0.12 coin per citizen per second before scaling). Riots and crime waves hit uncovered cities much harder.

> "I don't feel safe here. Where are the police?"

Provided by: Police station, Barracks.

## Healthcare

Key `health`. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -10%) and cut productivity by up to 20%, which shrinks every tax line. Epidemics and heat waves are far worse without it.

> "The nearest clinic is miles away."

Provided by: Clinic, Hospital.

## Education

Key `edu`. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -8%). Educated cities earn up to 30% more residential and industrial tax, and office buildings need it to run at full productivity.

> "The kids need a school."

Provided by: School, Library, University.

## Leisure

Key `leisure`. Parks, plazas, cinemas and stadiums. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -12%). Citizens also spend their evenings and weekends in leisure buildings.

> "This city needs a park."

Provided by: Park, Playground, Plaza, Cinema, Church, Bar, Stadium, Theme park, Shopping mall.

## Culture

Key `culture`. Libraries, museums and plazas. Covered homes gain up to +5% mood. Culture also draws visitors who spend money.

> "There's more to life than work. Thank goodness for the museum."

Provided by: Library, University, Plaza, Cinema, Museum, Church, Stadium.

## Public transport

Key `transit`. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -6%). Citizens in covered homes walk 30% faster to work and leisure.

> "Getting around this city is a nightmare."

Provided by: Bus stop, Train station.

## Electricity

Key `power`. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -15%) and reduce productivity by up to 25%. Power plants have a radius, so spread them and combine sources.

> "The lights keep going out."

Provided by: Wind turbine, Solar farm, Coal power plant.

## Water

Key `water`. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -15%) and productivity by up to 15%. Droughts and burst mains cut coverage.

> "We've got no running water!"

Provided by: Water tower.

## Sewage

Key `sewage`. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -10%) and make people sick more often. Sewers must reach a treatment plant; demand above plant capacity overloads the whole network.

> "The drains are backing up and the smell is awful."

Provided by: Sewage plant.

## Waste disposal

Key `waste`. Uncovered homes lower mood (up to -8%). Landfills handle waste cheaply but smell; recycling centres do it cleanly.

> "Rubbish is piling up in the streets."

Provided by: Landfill, Recycling centre.

## Retail strength

Key `commerce`. Markets and malls. Covered homes boost shop sales by up to 25%.

> "Shopping has never been this easy."

Provided by: Train station, Market, Shopping mall.

## Banking

Key `finance`. Banks. Covered homes raise all tax income by up to 12%.

> "My savings are finally earning something."

Provided by: Bank, Chamber of commerce.

## Street lighting

Key `light`. Lit blocks have less crime (up to -25% of the crime score). Lamps reach only a few tiles, so place them where crime is highest.

> "These streets are far too dark after sunset."

Provided by: Street lamp.

## Justice

Key `justice`. Courts and prisons. Covered blocks have up to 35% less crime, and mafia events fade sooner. Criminals who are caught stay off the streets.

> "Nobody ever gets prosecuted around here."

Provided by: Courthouse, Prison.

## Defence

Key `defence`. Bases and radar posts. Covered homes gain up to +2% mood, and border incidents hit covered towns far less.

> "At least we're protected out here."

Provided by: Military base, Radar post.

## Civic administration

Key `gov`. Town hall reach. Covered homes gain up to +4% mood, and the city loses less to fines and audits.

> "At least the council answers my letters."

Provided by: Union hall, Town hall.
